# Testimonial list — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the testimonial list when customers speak: figure cards of customer quotes. `items` are data — id, quote, author, role — rendered as figure cards under the section's `title`, and without items there is no section. Each figure pairs the quote with author and role, so the attribution is part of the card rather than decoration, and the list is a labelled testimonials region, so quotes announce as a set under the section heading. There is no carousel behaviour — quotes render as a list and rotation is the host's — and no avatar handling, because attribution is text and photos are a different card.
